audience: teams that monitor cold storage and temperature-sensitive goods with Temp Stick

useCases.title: Find sensors that have not checked in
useCases.text: List the sensors with their names, ids and last and next check-in times in UTC.

useCases.title: Review readings for a chosen time range
useCases.text: Read one sensor's details, then its temperature, humidity and voltage readings for a chosen time range, such as the last 24 hours.

useCases.title: Review recent temperature alerts
useCases.text: List alert notifications with the sensor id, the message and the created time in UTC.

useCases.title: Check a sensor's battery and signal
useCases.text: Read the voltage and RSSI values in a sensor's readings to check its battery and signal.
